Nulucre wallet reputation scoring (0-100) across 81+ chains with ECDSA signed proofs and DeFi TVL fact verification via x402 micropayments on Base mainnet and Stellar pubnet. # Registry Update Checklist Registry: - [x] I've made the left side of the colon of JSON entry in index.json match the potential NPM package name - [x] I've used github not github.com - [x] There is no .git extension - [x] I've dealt with commas properly so the list is still valid JSON Plugin repo: - [x] is publically accessible - [x] uses main as its default branch - [x] included elizaos-plugins in topics - [x] added description in github repo - [x] images/banner.jpg and images/logo.jpg included ## Discord username nulucredbalegacychain ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added support for new plugin mapping. * **Chores** * Updated configuration file formatting.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single entry to `index.json` registering `@elizaos/plugin-nulucre`, a wallet reputation scoring and DeFi TVL verification plugin by `vjshaw`. The change is minimal and follows registry conventions. - The JSON entry is well-formed: the previous last entry correctly received a trailing comma, and the file now closes with `}` and a newline (fixing the previous missing newline at EOF). - The key `@elizaos/plugin-nulucre` uses the `@elizaos/` scope pointing to a third-party repo (`vjshaw/plugin-nulucre`), which is an established pattern in this registry (e.g., `@elizaos/client-clara → redstone-finance`, `@elizaos/plugin-ATTPs → APRO-com`, etc.). - No duplicate entries found. - Format checklist items (no `.git` extension, uses `github:` prefix, valid JSON commas) all appear satisfied.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — single JSON entry addition with no structural issues. The change is a single-line registry entry addition. JSON is valid, formatting follows established conventions, and no P1/P0 issues were identified. No files require special attention.
